purpose: Define the smallest diverse, repeated, candidate-comparable real evidence set for the three Phase-2 Scenario categories.

repeat_and_stability.score_variance: Report population variance across valid repeated numeric scores for each task and candidate; disagreement is retained, never averaged away without disclosure.
repeat_and_stability.success_rate: successful admitted runs / all attempted runs, with PARTIAL, FAILED, and timeout attempts retained in the denominator.
repeat_and_stability.latency_variation: Across successful admitted runs report median as primary plus mean, min, max, interquartile range, and coefficient of variation.
repeat_and_stability.failed_latency_handling: Exclude FAILED and timeout durations from the latency distribution but retain them in reliability reporting.
repeat_and_stability.outlier_policy: Do not remove successful latency observations in V0.1.
repeat_and_stability.stability_interpretation: Two runs are a minimum instability screen, not a high-powered statistical estimate.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Generate one small function under explicit interface and forbidden-operation constraints.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Locally executed bounded tests produce a numeric pass ratio; rule checks enforce output and forbidden-operation constraints.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Repair one localized defect without changing an explicit public contract.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Regression and non-regression tests produce a numeric pass ratio; contract-preservation rules are binary.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Produce a constrained code change with required and forbidden elements.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Rule-based checks score required fields, forbidden content, and requested format.

insufficient_evidence_when: fewer than three distinct required tasks have valid Task Scores
fewer than five of six observations succeed
any diversity class has no valid evidence
coverage is below one or confidence is below HIGH
required correctness or constraint metrics are missing

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Produce a structured plan satisfying several explicit hard constraints.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Rule checks score every required constraint and numeric coverage records the satisfied fraction.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Order dependent steps while preserving prerequisites and stop conditions.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Structured dependency checks validate precedence and required milestones.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Allocate limited resources and identify mitigations for declared risks.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Required-field, budget-bound, forbidden-action, and mitigation coverage checks are rule-based and numeric.

insufficient_evidence_when: fewer than three distinct required tasks have valid Task Scores
fewer than five of six observations succeed
any dependency, constraint, or resource-risk diversity class is missing
coverage is below one or confidence is below HIGH
required feasibility or constraint metrics are missing

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Return a short answer in one exact machine-checkable format.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Exact Match or required-field checks with only explicitly declared normalization.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Satisfy multiple simultaneous content and structure requirements.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Rule-based contains, required-fields, and bounded numeric checks cover every condition.

minimum_real_benchmark_set.purpose: Follow positive requirements while omitting explicitly prohibited content.
minimum_real_benchmark_set.deterministic_evaluation: Rule-based required and not-contains checks must both pass.

insufficient_evidence_when: fewer than three distinct required tasks have valid Task Scores
fewer than five of six observations succeed
any format, multi-condition, or prohibition diversity class is missing
coverage is below one or confidence is below HIGH
required Exact Match or rule-based evidence is missing

minimum_set_rationale.why_three_tasks: Three is the smallest set that covers all three mandated diversity classes and reaches the existing Capability Profile HIGH-confidence evidence floor of three distinct tasks when coverage is at least 0.9.
minimum_set_rationale.why_two_runs: Two runs per task are the smallest repeat design that can reveal immediate non-determinism while keeping the campaign bounded; a single deterministic run remains preliminary only.
minimum_set_rationale.why_five_successes: Five successes out of six permit one operational failure without hiding broad instability and preserve evidence for every required task.
minimum_set_rationale.why_two_candidates: A real comparative recommendation requires at least two separately identified provider/model candidates measured on the same evidence surface.
